messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — PR #18177 is ready to land but CI is backed up. Need approvals + a rebase window before the deploy freeze starts at 2024-06-20 18:00 UTC. Can reviewers give ETA? /cc @maria_ops @sam_eng

maria_ops: Looking now. Failing test in integration-redis. Will try to rerun. @ci-bot can you retry jobs?

ci-bot: Triggered retry for job 18177-main (build/integ) — queued position 8. ETA ~15m.

sam_eng: I can review but need one small change (naming). Will add comments in PR. If it's just formatting we can merge before freeze, otherwise hold.

alex_k: thanks. If the test is flaky we can pin to slower runner? also open to postponing to Monday if it risks the canary.

jen_release: Our freeze window is 6h from 18:00 UTC; if we miss it today, landing would be delayed and cause backlog. Can someone triage the integ failure quickly.

maria_ops: Reproduced locally, looks like timeout in redis connection for long seqs. Pushing a one-line fix. cc @sam_eng if okay I'll force-push.

sam_eng: OK go ahead. After force-push I'll re-run my review. Please add a short changelog in the PR description.

ci-bot: Job rerun complete: integ still failing on stress-redis-2. Flaky test flagged. @maria_ops set retry_count=2 recommended.

alex_k: If flaky, let's fallback to canary plan: land on canary tag first (no auto-deploy) and monitor. If tests still fail in canary we abort. Who can do the canary tag and set rollout to 10%?

jen_release: I can create canary tag and route 10% to dedicated pool. But need PR merged with 'canary-ok' label. @sam_eng can you add label after approving?

sam_eng: LGTM, added approval and left comment about changelog. Adding label now.

maria_ops: Force-pushed fix at 1717401560. CI rerun requested: `/ci retry 18177-main`

ci-bot: Rerun queued; new build id 18177-main-2. Position 3.

ci-bot: Build succeeded ✅ all checks passed.

jen_release: Great. I've created canary tag 'canary/18177' and set rollout 10%. Monitor dashboards for 30m. I'll pause final rollout until you confirm.

alex_k: thanks team. Will watch logs; if nothing noisy, request full rollout at +30m. Marking this thread resolved unless new failures.

sam_eng: sounds good. thx 🙏
